posts.title: Important Nashsite RSS update!
posts.description: Hello! Thanks for subscribing to my RSS feed! I just found out this particular feed hasn't been working on all readers, probably because I didn't put a file extension on the XML file. I just added the extension, but that means for all of y'all who've already subscribed, you'll need to re-subscribe. The new feed URL is: https://nashhigh.com/rss.rss
